statements_requiring_review.original_statement: SELECT BusinessEntityID, FORMAT(ModifiedDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS FormattedModifiedDate, DATEDIFF(YEAR, BirthDate, GETDATE()) AS Age FROM bobsbookstore_dbo.author WHERE DATEPART(YEAR, HireDate) = @HireDate;
statements_requiring_review.converted_statement: SELECT BusinessEntityID, TO_CHAR(ModifiedDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FormattedModifiedDate, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, BirthDate)) AS Age FROM bobsbookstore_dbo.author WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM HireDate) = @HireDate;
statements_requiring_review.testing_recommendation: Manual testing with sample data to verify FORMAT→TO_CHAR, DATEDIFF→AGE+EXTRACT conversions produce identical results, especially for edge cases (leap years, timezone handling)
